name: Bitfinex
rootCause: On May 22, 2015, Bitfinex's hot wallet keys were compromised, allowing an attacker to withdraw approximately 1,500 BTC (then valued around $330,000). Bitfinex absorbed the loss and replaced all affected wallet infrastructure. The incident stemmed from single-key hot wallet exposure rather than a flaw in the core platform or multisig cold storage. Exposure or compromise of the single-signature private key associated with Bitfinex's hot wallet allowed unauthorized withdrawals. The exact method of compromise has not been published.
